items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: What was the name of Percy Fernandez's place?

ctx.x: Thank you. I finally got the strife.

The Salvador Room was manager in place. It was a Greek room there. On Burgundy between Canal and... What was the name of Percy Fernandez's place? Was the one on Burgundy upstairs? Did you have to climb upstairs together? The one on Burgundy. It was on the ground floor? That was one of the places. It was a diamond dance hall after. Yeah, it was called a point dance hall. Is it called that the toy? Was it toy? No, no. See, on the corner across from the Lyric Theatre was the Raleigh. Oh, yeah. The Haymarket was…
What was the Haymarket? The Haymarket was a cabaret.
